title: Strict runtime evidence lacks a detached producer receipt for full-matrix artifacts
title_de: Strikte Runtime-Evidence besitzt keinen abgekoppelten Producer-Receipt für Full-Matrix-Artefakte
summary: The strict result consumer recomputes a leaf result hash but trusts the mutable job receipt and raw-matrix row that declare that hash. A forged PASS JSONL with synchronized job.json and raw-row hash fields is accepted because the detached verified-commands receipt binds only command completion, not the full artifact set.
summary_de: Der strikte Result-Consumer berechnet einen Leaf-Result-Hash neu, vertraut aber dem veränderbaren Job-Receipt und der Raw-Matrix-Zeile, die diesen Hash deklarieren. Eine gefälschte PASS-JSONL mit synchronisierten Hash-Feldern in job.json und Raw-Zeile wird akzeptiert, weil der abgekoppelte verified-commands-Receipt nur Command-Completion, nicht das vollständige Artefaktset bindet.
observed_behavior: A valid temporary full run was modified after receipt creation by replacing one connector result JSONL with forged PASS content and updating hashes.results_jsonl in the matching job.json plus the matching full-runtime-matrix-runs.jsonl row. check_verified_runtime_artifact_chain returned no errors. Raw-to-job equality is therefore self-authenticating rather than anchored in a producer-owned immutable aggregate receipt.
observed_behavior_de: Ein gültiger temporärer Full-Run wurde nach der Receipt-Erstellung verändert: Eine Connector-Result-JSONL wurde durch gefälschten PASS-Inhalt ersetzt und hashes.results_jsonl in der passenden job.json sowie der passenden full-runtime-matrix-runs.jsonl-Zeile aktualisiert. check_verified_runtime_artifact_chain lieferte keine Fehler. Die Raw-zu-Job-Gleichheit ist damit selbst-authentifizierend statt in einem Producer-eigenen unveränderlichen Aggregate-Receipt verankert.
expected_behavior: A trusted Parent producer writes one canonical, regular, per-run aggregate receipt under verified-runs/<run-id>/ after the complete matrix stage. It binds the raw matrix, every canonical job receipt, and required leaf artifacts by expected identity, canonical path, byte count, and SHA-256. The strict consumer validates that aggregate receipt before accepting mutable job or raw records.
expected_behavior_de: Ein vertrauenswürdiger Parent-Producer schreibt nach der vollständigen Matrix-Phase genau einen kanonischen regulären per-Run-Aggregate-Receipt unter verified-runs/<run-id>/. Er bindet Raw-Matrix, jeden kanonischen Job-Receipt und erforderliche Leaf-Artefakte über erwartete Identität, kanonischen Pfad, Byte-Anzahl und SHA-256. Der strikte Consumer validiert diesen Aggregate-Receipt, bevor er veränderbare Job- oder Raw-Records akzeptiert.
impact: An actor able to modify retained runtime artifacts after job receipt creation can make a forged PASS result internally consistent with mutable receipts and pass the strict consumer. This defeats hash-based result-file authenticity under the stated untrusted-artifact threat model.
impact_de: Ein Akteur, der aufbewahrte Runtime-Artefakte nach Erstellung des Job-Receipts verändern kann, kann ein gefälschtes PASS-Result intern mit veränderbaren Receipts konsistent machen und den strikten Consumer bestehen lassen. Dies unterläuft hash-basierte Result-Datei-Authentizität im angegebenen Untrusted-Artifact-Bedrohungsmodell.
preconditions: A full-matrix artifact tree and its job/raw receipts are writable or replaceable after the job producer records its hashes.
The strict consumer relies on the existing mutable raw matrix and job receipt fields without a detached aggregate seal.
reproduction: Build the focused valid temporary twelve-cell run fixture.
Replace one results JSONL with forged PASS content.
Update the matching job.json hashes.results_jsonl and matching raw-manifest row hashes.results_jsonl.
Invoke check_verified_runtime_artifact_chain and observe no errors before the separate fix.

GitHub PR/check/CodeQL/Sonar/review snapshot plus git diff --check for PR #59 exact head d4f88b886dac6fd5f483940015d6310bc239f814
evidence.summary: PR #59 head has the detached aggregate-receipt and descriptor-relative hardening; all observed exact-head checks passed, but the Draft is behind current Parent master and requires a fresh exact-head cycle.

evidence.command: Exact PR #59 head b9b22cc36958ba506278f3aa3fbc1d383ea6a151 passed current non-skipped CI, CodeQL, SonarQube Cloud and zero review/thread gates; after protected squash merge to Parent master 5a22cbf5206dbc2b7f53a9f961d72e37d567e188, run tests.test_generated_report_evidence_integrity (57/57), tests.test_bilingual_docs (11/11), sh -n ci/runtime/lifecycle/run-full-matrix-parallel.sh, and git diff --check.
evidence.summary: The paired mutable result/job/raw forgery and alternate rewrite controls fail closed while the valid complete twelve-cell aggregate receipt control passes. FND-SONAR-0001 remains an independent unaccepted global master Sonar failure.

root_cause: The current run-level verified-commands record proves only that the full-matrix command completed. It omits a detached inventory of the raw matrix, job JSON receipts, and leaf artifact hashes. The strict checker therefore compares two mutable documents that can be changed together.
root_cause_de: Der aktuelle run-weite verified-commands-Record beweist nur, dass der Full-Matrix-Command abgeschlossen wurde. Er enthält kein abgekoppeltes Inventar der Raw-Matrix, der Job-JSON-Receipts und Leaf-Artefakt-Hashes. Der strikte Checker vergleicht daher zwei veränderbare Dokumente, die gemeinsam geändert werden können.
proposed_remediation: Commit 3966707c4e42006edd91eb8d0c7510940592ed84 implements the separate stacked Parent aggregate receipt producer after the full-matrix runtime stage, records it by path/hash/bytes, and makes the strict consumer compare the expected twelve-cell raw/job/leaf inventory to the receipt. It includes paired-forgery, alternate mutation, foreign-run generator, resume, and valid-control coverage. FND-PARENT-0037 remains a separate descriptor-relative path-confinement prerequisite before this receipt chain can be considered fully verified.
proposed_remediation_de: Commit 3966707c4e42006edd91eb8d0c7510940592ed84 implementiert den separaten gestapelten Parent-Aggregate-Receipt-Producer nach der Full-Matrix-Runtime-Phase, zeichnet ihn über Pfad/Hash/Bytes auf und lässt den strikten Consumer das erwartete Zwölf-Zellen-Raw-/Job-/Leaf-Inventar mit dem Receipt vergleichen. Er enthält gekoppelte-Fälschung-, Alternativmutation-, Fremd-Run-Generator-, Resume- und gültige-Kontroll-Coverage. FND-PARENT-0037 bleibt eine separate descriptor-relative Path-Confinement-Voraussetzung, bevor diese Receipt-Kette als vollständig verifiziert gelten kann.
acceptance_criteria: A result JSONL forged together with mutable job.json and raw-matrix hash fields is rejected.
A detached per-run aggregate receipt binds raw matrix, all twelve job receipts, required log/build-manifest/summary/result artifacts, and their canonical identities, byte counts, and hashes.
The aggregate receipt is regular, run-ID-bound, and itself bound into the verified run manifest; descriptor-relative path confinement is tracked independently by FND-PARENT-0037.
A valid complete control run passes after aggregate receipt creation.
The user-authorized combined Parent Draft PR preserves distinct FND-PARENT-0030/-0031/-0037 traceability; no Framework or MRTS change or merge occurs.
validation_plan: Add the paired mutable-receipt forgery fixture before the producer or consumer change and demonstrate the pre-fix acceptance.
Run focused report-evidence integrity tests, generator/producer tests, shell syntax, in-memory Python compilation, bilingual docs, governance-only and expected strict checks.

Completed: exact PR #59 source head b9b22cc36958ba506278f3aa3fbc1d383ea6a151 passed all non-skipped protected checks, required contexts, CodeQL, SonarQube Cloud Quality Gate, issue query, and zero-review/thread controls; protected squash merge produced Parent master 5a22cbf5206dbc2b7f53a9f961d72e37d567e188 with an identical tree, where detached-master 57/57 original-reproduction and legitimate-control evidence, bilingual 11/11, shell syntax, diff, and clean/no-.pyc checks passed.
The FND-SONAR-0001 global master error is independent of this verification and is neither accepted nor suppressed.
legitimate_control_tests: A full canonical twelve-cell run with a matching aggregate receipt passes.
A completed_with_mismatches run remains schema-valid when its aggregate receipt and required artifacts match.
dependencies: FND-PARENT-0030 strict canonical consumer branch is the prerequisite for the aggregate-receipt consumer seam.
FND-PARENT-0037 descriptor-relative receipt-path remediation is required before final verified disposition.
deduplication_note: Not a duplicate of FND-PARENT-0030. FND-PARENT-0030 validates canonical paths, status schema, and mutable leaf/job/raw consistency; this finding is the independent missing producer-authenticity anchor that prevents synchronized receipt forgery.
residual_risk: The receipt chain is not a signature, ACL, process-identity, UID-isolation, or external-attestation boundary. Mode 0400 limits group/other access only; arbitrary same-UID write access to the Parent evidence namespace remains outside this local filesystem trust model. No risk is accepted. The exact b9b22cc36958ba506278f3aa3fbc1d383ea6a151 PR gates and resulting master 5a22cbf5206dbc2b7f53a9f961d72e37d567e188 original-reproduction and legitimate controls are verified, not closed. FND-CROSS-0001 separately blocks real current runtime evidence and FND-SONAR-0001 separately fails the global master Quality Gate without attribution to this finding.
residual_risk_de: Die Receipt-Kette ist keine Signatur-, ACL-, Prozessidentitäts-, UID-Isolations- oder External-Attestation-Grenze. Modus 0400 beschränkt nur Group-/Other-Zugriff; beliebiger Same-UID-Schreibzugriff auf den Parent-Evidence-Namespace bleibt außerhalb dieses lokalen Filesystem-Trust-Modells. Es wird kein Risiko akzeptiert. Die exakten b9b22cc36958ba506278f3aa3fbc1d383ea6a151-PR-Gates und die Original-Reproduktion sowie legitimen Kontrollen auf resultierendem Master 5a22cbf5206dbc2b7f53a9f961d72e37d567e188 sind verified, nicht closed. FND-CROSS-0001 blockiert reale aktuelle Runtime-Evidence getrennt und FND-SONAR-0001 lässt das globale Master-Quality-Gate ohne Zuschreibung zu diesem Finding getrennt fehlschlagen.
